title: Sign-in form — ambiguous grouping is a data-entry error
prompt: 对 eval/cases/02-login/index.html 做设计评审（Workflow D，只诊断、不改文件）。Lumen 登录页，主色 #0f766e。有条件请打开页面看渲染。每条 finding 必须挂规则号。
pass_bar: Must flag equal label/input vs group spacing as P0-class grouping, two solid primaries, and raised shadows on inputs.

must.now: Label margin-bottom is 16px and .row margin-bottom is 16px — each label is as close to the previous field as to its own input
Sign in and Create account are both full-width solid buttons
Text inputs carry a large outer drop shadow and read as raised rather than inset

forbidden.why: Teal is the brand. Do not report missing indigo.
